dataset.title: NMNH Extant Specimen Records (USNM, US)
dataset.provider: National Museum of Natural History, Smithsonian Institution

catalogCrosscheck.result: The page served the JavaScript collection-search shell; the catalog fields were not exposed in the retrieved HTML, so direct NMNH catalog confirmation remains pending.
catalogCrosscheck.resolverResult: Resolved to the NMNH Fishes Collections Search application shell; record details were not independently visible in this retrieval.

taxonomicCrosscheck.finding: The primary description presents Stolephorus celsior from Manila Bay and lists type material collected at Rosario, Cavite. It does not mention USNM 204231 or Naic; therefore it supports the taxon and Manila Bay context but is not a direct crosswalk for this catalog number.
taxonomicCrosscheck.reuse: No item-specific article reuse license was verified. Only bibliographic metadata and a concise attributed finding are recorded; no table, figure, or extended text was reproduced.

decision.waterbodyAssociation: source-reported shared Manila Bay only; the GBIF waterBody field names Manila Bay and the locality names Naic, Cavite
decision.reason: This dated, CC0 GBIF-indexed preserved specimen is identified as an accepted species by H. Hata and explicitly reports Manila Bay as its waterBody. Retain it as a historical source-reported association with the shared bay. The direct NMNH catalog page could not be independently read, there are no coordinates, and neither the record nor the taxonomic paper links it to Palanas River (Naic).

nextAction: If the NMNH collection interface becomes readable, compare the catalog entry and original locality label for USNM 204231. Keep the record attached only to shared Manila Bay unless that primary record contradicts GBIF fields; never transfer it to Palanas River on the basis of Naic locality alone.
